subject: Pegasus security onboarding — evidence consolidation & access choreography
messages:
From: Sally Jensen <sally.jensen@pegasushealth.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: security@pegasushealth.com
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 15:13:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — evidence snapshot request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. We're running a short intake for vendors that will be part of the Pegasus patient-data pipeline. Our security team prefers to collect a consolidated evidence snapshot (SIG + CAIQ + latest SOC2 summary) rather than dozens of ad-hoc attachments.

Quick asks to scope the onboarding:
- Do you support uploading a single CSV SIG export + a CAIQ JSON/zip into OneTrust/Vendr?
- Can Redwood provision a temporary read-only service account so Pegasus can pull a signed evidence bundle?
- We're aiming for a 9/15 target to complete the initial review — is that workable?

I've attached a small report from our vendor scanner and exported a SIG template (pegasus_SIG_export_v1.csv). We'll accept either OneTrust or Vendr profile handoff — whichever is faster to provision.

If useful, copy in your security ops for the staging details.

Cheers,
Sally Jensen
Security Manager, Pegasus Health
security@pegasushealth.com

Attachment: pegasus_SIG_export_v1.csv (CSV, 42KB)
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: Sally Jensen <sally.jensen@pegasushealth.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 17:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — evidence snapshot request

Sally — thanks for the clear ask and the export. We can absolutely consolidate. High-level plan below and a couple of operational questions.

Plan (short):
1) We will export our SIG/CAIQ artifacts into a single zipped evidence bundle and stage on a read-only S3 bucket with pre-signed URLs (or push the bundle into Vendr/OneTrust if you prefer portal handoff).
2) Provide a time-limited service account with read-only access (scoped to the staging bucket) for Pegasus security to pull the bundle.
3) Share a short manifest (checksums + mapping of each artifact to SIG/CAIQ control IDs) and a pointer to our SOC 2 summary.

Operational Qs:
- Which portal would you prefer for the primary profile (OneTrust or Vendr)? If OneTrust, can you share the onboarding email for the profile invite? If Vendr, we can push a profile export.
- For the service account, do you need temporary keys or an STS flow? We support both; STS is preferred for auditability.

Jonas and Rishi — looping you both to coordinate the staging bucket + manifest. Kimberly, want to include you for the SOC2 cert extract and redaction check.

I can commit to the 9/15 window if we can get portal access or the presigned-read window by 9/10.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Immediate tasks (assign):
- Jonas: provision an s3 staging prefix under /pegasus/onboarding/ and create an STS role that Pegasus can assume for read-only (expiry 72h). Please include object ACLs for checksums.
- Rishi: generate the CAIQ JSON and SIG export bundle from our vault, and produce the manifest.csv that maps each file to SIG control IDs. Include MD5/SHA256.
- Kimberly: pull the latest SOC2 summary PDF and redact any vendor-specific PII; confirm redaction by EOD 9/9.

Let's aim to have the presigned URL + manifest to Sally by 9/10. I'll take responsibility for the communication and for pushing to Vendr/OneTrust if Pegasus prefers portal handoff.

-Marissa
